_note: Episode 28 (S3E8), story version 2, Kabanata 28: Kawit (present; the signboard of an invented flood-wall project, no real project, official or contractor), Mount Banahaw and its devotees (from behind, with respect, no group named), the Lucban shrine, the 1841 jump (Hermano Pule and the cofradía only from far behind, no faces, no words; the October 1841 fight and the broken camp with restraint; the execution is NOT shown: Usman turns away with soldiers' silhouettes out of focus), the cave, M and Giliw at the cave mouth, the passage (not the present, so Usman appears), Lolo Isidro and the tambuli. Prompts are setting-first with short character strings; the free endpoint filters brick, violet, museum. Intro copied from Episode 11. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k96 are montage extras. Shot 73 reuses flash_beam: every wording of the seven rings was refused by the free endpoint's filter (30 seeds).
